```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load necessary libraries
install.packages("psych")
install.packages("ggplot2")
install.packages("factoextra")

library(psych)        # For factor analysis
library(cluster)      # For clustering analysis
library(ggplot2)      # For visualizations
library(factoextra)   # For visualizing clusters

# Load dataset
data <- Smart_Phone_Survey  # Replace with the path to your dataset

```

# Step 1: Select Relevant Columns
```{}

# For Q6
selected_data_q6 <- data[, c("imp_brand", "imp_screen_size", "imp_screen_resolution", "imp_battery_life", "imp_appearance", "imp_storage","imp_weight", "imp_durability", "imp_price","imp_wifi", "imp_operating", "imp_camera")]


# For Q7 
selected_data_q7 <- data[, c("psych_stay_productive", "psych_successful_career","psych_price_important", "psych_strict_budget","psych_search_best_deal", "psych_tech_prestige_symbol", "psych_latest_phone_functions", "psych_own_latest_tech","psych_smartphone_identity", "psych_brand_reflect_self","psych_care_others", "psych_follow_fashion")]

```

```{}
# Choose dataset for analysis
selected_data <- selected_data_q6 
```

# Step 2: Standardize Data

```{}
scaled_data <- scale(selected_data)
scaled_data
```

#Scree plot
```{}
# Perform PCA with the same nfactors = 3 (as you did before)
fa_result <- principal(scaled_data, nfactors = 2, rotate = "varimax")

# Plot the scree plot
plot(fa_result$values, type = "b", pch = 19, 
     xlab = "Factor Number", ylab = "Eigenvalue",
     main = "Scree Plot")
```


# Step 3: Perform Factor Analysis
```{}
fa_result <- principal(scaled_data, nfactors = 2, rotate = "varimax", scores = TRUE)
print(fa_result)

# Extract factor scores
factor_scores <- as.data.frame(fa_result$scores)

print(fa_result$loadings)
```

```{}
graphics.off()  # Resets all graphics devices
```


# Step 4: Determine Optimal Number of Clusters
```{}
fviz_nbclust(factor_scores, kmeans, method = "silhouette")
```

# Step 5: Perform K-Means Clustering

```{}
optimal_clusters <- 3  # Adjust based on silhouette plot
kmeans_result <- kmeans(factor_scores, centers = optimal_clusters, nstart = 25)
```

# Step 6: Profile Clusters

```{}
cluster_profile <- aggregate(selected_data, by = list(Cluster = kmeans_result$cluster), FUN = mean)
print(cluster_profile)
```


# Step 7: Visualize Clusters
```{}
ggplot(factor_scores, aes(x = RC1, y = RC2, color = as.factor(kmeans_result$cluster))) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Performance and Utility", y = "Aesthetic and Design", color = "Cluster") +
  theme_minimal()

```


###### NOW FOR Q7:#######

```{}
# Choose dataset for analysis
selected_data2 <- selected_data_q7
```

# Step 2: Standardize Data

```{}
scaled_data2 <- scale(selected_data2)
scaled_data2
```

#Scree plot
```{}
# Perform PCA with the same nfactors = 3 (as you did before)
fa_result2 <- principal(scaled_data2, nfactors = 2, rotate = "varimax")

# Plot the scree plot
plot(fa_result2$values, type = "b", pch = 19, 
     xlab = "Factor Number", ylab = "Eigenvalue",
     main = "Scree Plot")
```


# Step 3: Perform Factor Analysis
```{}

fa_result2 <- principal(scaled_data2, nfactors = 5, rotate = "varimax")  

# Extract factor scores
factor_scores2 <- as.data.frame(fa_result2$scores)

print(fa_result2$loadings)
```



# Step 4: Determine Optimal Number of Clusters
```{}
fviz_nbclust(factor_scores2, kmeans, method = "silhouette") +
  labs(title = "Optimal Number of Clusters (Silhouette Method)")

```

# Step 5: Perform K-Means Clustering

```{}
# Choose the optimal number of clusters based on the silhouette plot
optimal_clusters2 <- 2

# Perform k-means clustering
kmeans_result2 <- kmeans(factor_scores2, centers = optimal_clusters2, nstart = 25)

# Add cluster labels to the factor scores for easier visualization
factor_scores2$Cluster <- as.factor(kmeans_result2$cluster)

```

# Step 6: Profile Clusters

```{}
# Compute the mean of the original variables for each cluster
cluster_profile2 <- aggregate(selected_data2, by = list(Cluster = kmeans_result2$cluster), FUN = mean)

# Print the cluster profiles for interpretation
print(cluster_profile2)

```


# Step 7: Visualize Clusters
```{}

ggplot(factor_scores2, aes(x = RC1, y = RC2, color = Cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Cluster Visualization (Q7)",
    x = "Factor 1: Social Status & Identity",
    y = "Factor 2: Tech Enthusiasm & Innovation",
    color = "Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```
